# The tests protect when a folder kept for entries this device leaves out goes to the local trash: once the entries leave,
# at a restart, after a batch that renames the folder above, with platform files or with rules files that hold no local
# edit, and never while a rules file holds an edit, including one made after the server purged it or saved with
# unchanged bytes. Each case takes a path in the recheck or in the scan that lists the folder that no other test reaches,
# and the cases that share setup already run as tables over .koiignore and .gitignore and over edited and unedited files.
